en: The objective of this special screening{SAUT}is to deactivate A.I.G.I.S.'s new{SAUT}security system and escape.{PAGE}The technology found there certainly is{SAUT}surprising―dare I say, out of this world{SAUT}or perhaps O.M.G.{PAGE}In light of this change in security, I'd{SAUT}like you to investigate.
